lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting with horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The dorsal fin displays a high density of small, irregularly shaped high-luminance spots distributed across its visible lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, linear white mark resembling a superficial scratch is visible on the upper flank, posterior to the dorsal fin position.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, striped teleost fish (pilot fish) clustered near the ventral surface and the pectoral fin.
